notes: All 24 names are kept. No row is dropped. Every evidence site was opened and every quote is on its line. 10 rows changed in meaning: GITHUB_WORKSPACE, GIT_TERMINAL_PROGRESS, HF_TOKEN, HOME, HPCTIXFILE, HTTPS_PROXY, IN_NIX_SHELL, LDFLAGS, LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS and LOGNAME. HTTP_PROXY changed in evidence only. HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS and LANG changed in wording only. The other 11 rows are unchanged. The quote of ingest/build-all.sh:103 in the HPCTIXFILE row is the exact tail of the source line and not the whole line. The start of that line holds the shell pipe character, which the table format forbids. Rulings asked by the writer. HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY keep tron_use `reads and sets`. The lower-case rows of chunk external-06 use the same value. The ALL_PROXY row of chunk external-01 (`sets`) and the NO_PROXY row of chunk external-04 (`unsets`) need the same treatment, or all 6 rows need one other common choice. LNAME stays a row of its own. The USERNAME row of chunk external-06 has the same situation and is kept there. IOTOOLS_STATIC stays, for consistency with the ARCHFLAGS, STATIC and SBINDIR rows. HPCTIXFILE stays in group `sanitizers`. The group definition includes coverage run times. The GHCRTS row of chunk external-02 uses `build-tools`. Facts in cells that do not come from the checkout. (1) `getpass.getuser()` tries LOGNAME, USER, LNAME, USERNAME in this order, and `urllib` prefers the lower-case proxy names. Both were read again in the Python 3.10.12 source on the server of this check. (2) `Path.home()` uses the password database when HOME is unset (HOME row, Python standard library). (3) `if(DEFINED ENV{IN_NIX_SHELL})` is true for an empty value. This was measured with CMake 3.22.1 and a 5-line script outside the checkout. (4) The `defined_by` cell of LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS rests on the LLVM documentation, not on the checkout. GIT_TERMINAL_PROGRESS: the program /usr/bin/git, version 2.34.1, on the server of this check contains the text GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT and does not contain GIT_TERMINAL_PROGRESS (checked with `strings`). The row does not use this fact. LDFLAGS: CMake 3.22 adds the environment value only to the defaults of the linker flag variables (Modules/CMakeCommonLanguageInclude.cmake of the CMake installation). The preset `base-ninja` sets all 3 variables. No build was run. The row therefore does not state whether `-lgcc_s` reaches a link command. The limit of 35 words for the external section is applied to every effect cell.

changes.name: IN_NIX_SHELL
changes.was: It marks a run inside the Nix dev shell. CMake takes `python3` from `PATH`. `rust/run-cargo` uses the Rust toolchain of `TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN`. `make deb` and `make deb-host` stop with an error.
changes.now: It marks a run inside the Nix dev shell. CMake takes `python3` from `PATH`. `rust/run-cargo` requires `TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN` and uses that Rust toolchain. `make deb` and `make deb-host` stop with an error.
changes.why: With `IN_NIX_SHELL` not empty, `rust/run-cargo` stops when `TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN` is unset or empty (rust/run-cargo:11). The old cell said only that the script uses that toolchain. A person who sets `IN_NIX_SHELL` by hand outside `nix develop` gets this error.

changes.name: IN_NIX_SHELL
changes.was: `nix develop` sets it. `flake.nix` sets it for Nix check builds and for its `lefthook` (the Git hook runner) wrapper. Inside Nix, 4 make targets (`ingest-deps`, `bin-deps`, `tokenize-deps`, `ci-deps`) skip `uv sync`. With `IN_NIX_SHELL` and `CI` both empty, `make` prints a deprecation warning.
changes.now: `nix develop` sets it. `flake.nix` sets `pure` for Nix builds and `impure` for its `lefthook` (the Git hook runner) wrapper. Inside Nix, 4 make targets (`ingest-deps`, `bin-deps`, `tokenize-deps`, `ci-deps`) skip `uv sync`. With `IN_NIX_SHELL` and `CI` both empty, a top-level `make` prints a deprecation warning.
changes.why: Added the 2 values that `flake.nix` sets: `pure` (flake.nix:1172, flake.nix:2123) and `impure` (flake.nix:1736). flake.nix:1172 also serves a dev shell and a package build (flake.nix:1176, flake.nix:1246). The old words `check builds` were too narrow. The warning needs `MAKELEVEL` 0 (GNUmakefile:2).

changes.name: LANG
changes.was: A script comment says that `LANG` must stay UTF-8. CMake archive extraction fails on non-ASCII paths under the C locale. The script passes a non-UTF-8 value on unchanged.
changes.now: A script comment says that `LANG` must stay UTF-8. The comment gives the reason: CMake archive extraction fails on non-ASCII paths under the C locale. The script passes a non-UTF-8 value on unchanged.
changes.why: The old second sentence stated the CMake failure as a fact of the row. It is a statement of the comment (bin/bsub-build:63, bin/bsub-build:64). The script does not check the value (bin/bsub-build:66).

changes.name: LDFLAGS

changes.now: No CMake file in the checkout names `LDFLAGS`. The preset `base-ninja` in `CMakePresets.json` sets `CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS` and 2 more linker flag variables itself. `bin/iotools-1.5` is a vendored copy of Google iotools 1.5. No TRON build file runs its makefile.

The preset `base-ninja` sets `CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS`, `CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS` and `CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS` to `-fuse-ld=lld-19` (CMakePresets.json:25, CMakePresets.json:26, CMakePresets.json:27). The checkout does not show that `-lgcc_s` reaches a TRON link command.

changes.name: LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS
changes.now: LLVM build system (a CMake option there)
changes.why: The LLVM project documents this name as a CMake cache option of its own build, not as an environment variable. In TRON it is set with `set(ENV{...})` (CMakeLists.txt:82), and no file reads it. The short `LLVM` suggested that an LLVM tool reads the environment value.

changes.name: LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS
changes.was: No file in the checkout reads it. Without support for link-time optimization, CMake prints a warning and does not set the variable.
changes.now: No file in the checkout reads it. The checkout does not show which program reads the environment value. Without support for link-time optimization, CMake prints a warning and does not set the variable.
changes.why: `git grep LLVM_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS` finds 1 line: CMakeLists.txt:82. The warning branch is CMakeLists.txt:84.

changes.name: LOGNAME
changes.was: `getpass.getuser()` takes the user name from it first. `bin/dice` builds its default runtime directory `/tmp/dice-<name>` from that name. `bin/dice_lsf_view.py` prints a warning when it cancels an LSF job of another owner.
changes.now: `getpass.getuser()` returns it first. `bin/dice` then keeps its socket, state and log files in `/tmp/dice-<name>` by default. `bin/dice_lsf_view.py` compares the name with the owner of an LSF job and warns when they differ.
changes.why: The old cell said that `bin/dice_lsf_view.py` warns when it cancels a job of another owner. The code compares the name with the job owner and warns on any difference (bin/dice_lsf_view.py:1239, bin/dice_lsf_view.py:1247). A wrong `LOGNAME` therefore causes a false warning. The directory holds `dice.sock`, `dice.state.json` and `dice.log` (bin/dice:429, bin/dice:434, bin/dice:439).
